messages:
Ava: Heads-up  Lumenix (recent onboarding) drove a surprise embeddings surge overnight, 24h delta +230%. Putting on QBR cost agenda and renewal watch. :warning:
Ben: Oof. Any idea which pipeline? Ingest worker, realtime, or a batch job?
Rhea: Quick triage  most traffic hitting /v1/embeddings from their nightly reindex. Looks like the job retried entire payloads after a partial failure.
infra-bot: ALERT account=lumenix metric=tokens_24h change=+230% link=https://app.redwood/alerts/lx-6200
Ava: Can we get a 7d vs 30d spend projection for the QBR so finance can model exposure and potential credit?
Ben: Running a quick snapshot. SQL used:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as t24h FROM usage WHERE account_id='lumenix' AND ts > now()-24h;
```
Posting numbers in ~4m.
Rhea: While Ben pulls numbers, I applied a temporary soft limit on /v1/embeddings (1.8M tokens/day) and routed non-critical jobs to a quantized embed flavor. infra-bot confirmed.
infra-bot: NOTE guard applied route=/v1/embeddings account=lumenix soft_limit=1800000 tokens/day. Ticket=CS-9987
Ben: 24h snapshot: 4.6M tokens. Projection (sustained) = ~138M / 30d. Conservative post-mitigation = 28-40M. Estimated spend if sustained ~$4.1k/month at current tier. CSV uploaded to CS-9987.
Ava: Thanks. For the QBR propose three options for finance + CS to consider: 1) monitor + enablement (no credit), 2) one-time goodwill credit + enablement, 3) small retainer + hands-on remediation. Suggest we draft recommended option and dollar bands.
Rhea: I'll run an enablement session tomorrow 11am PT: batching, cache-TTL, safe retries, and idempotency tokens. I'll include a 1-page SDK checklist and a small code snippet for exponential backoff.
Ben: Also adding a short slide showing cost delta if we keep the quantized fallback vs full model to show immediate savings if they accept fallback.
Ava: Finance  any guidance on a one-time credit threshold? If sustained it's material but if this was an accidental retry loop maybe a small credit is appropriate.
finance: If spike is customer-side bug and they engage in enablement, finance is OK with up to a $1k goodwill credit for onboarding incidents. Anything larger needs approvals.
Rhea: Noted. I'll capture customer acceptance of fallback and readiness to attend enablement; if they opt into the fallback we can propose reducing spend impact immediately.
Ava: Action owners: 1) QBR spend slides + scenarios (Ben) 2) enablement + checklist + post-call notes (Rhea) 3) throttle + fallback applied (Rhea/infra) 4) credit recommendation draft (Ava + finance).
Rhea: Also logging product asks from the call: a small client helper for safe batching and a server-side idempotency header for deduping replays. I'll mark quick-win vs longer-term.
infra-bot: NOTE: quantized model rollout active for non-critical embed jobs for lumenix. Monitor window=48h.
Ben: Uploaded slides and scenarios to the QBR folder. Conservative = $1.2k/mo (post-mitigation), sustained = $4.1k/mo. Drafting a recommended option: goodwill credit ($750) + mandatory enablement.
Ava: Sounds good. We'll present the recommendation in the QBR: engage + remediate with optional small credit to keep renewal health high. Marking renewal risk as "moderate; engage and remediate". Will update after enablement and ticket close. :white_check_mark:
